selection_method: SHA256(seed NUL filename), lowest hashes; selected before inspecting errors

ap_coverage.limitation: Predictions below the declared floor are unavailable; AP may change with lower confidence coverage.

metric_definition.ap50: Project all-point AP50 at retained-score floor .001; not full-score-range AP or official COCO AP
metric_definition.gt_matching: highest-IoU available same-class GT; in-range GT before ignored other-area GT
metric_definition.class_mean: mean over classes with GT; absent classes null
metric_definition.coco_status: not computed; requires official COCO evaluator
metric_definition.area_rules: bbox area in source pixels: small [0,1024), medium [1024,9216), large [9216,infinity); other-area matches/unmatched predictions ignored
